title.zh: 在等宽文本中，为右边界逐字斟酌
title.en: Choosing Every Word for a Monospace Right Margin

excerpt.zh: 一篇引发 Hacker News 关注的排版文章，讲述一份《超级银河战士》指南如何不用程序、只靠改写措辞，实现整齐的等宽两端对齐。
excerpt.en: A typography essay discussed on Hacker News examines how a Super Metroid guide achieved clean justified monospace text without software, simply by rewriting its wording.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 等宽排版的一个老难题
text.en: An Old Problem in Monospace Typesetting

text.zh: 等宽字体让每个字符占据相同宽度，带来清晰的网格感，也让文本排版的取舍格外显眼。左对齐通常自然易读；右对齐可以通过计算空格完成；但居中时，没有“半个空格”可用，视觉上的绝对均衡已经不容易。
text.en: Monospace type gives every character the same width, creating a clear grid while making typographic compromises especially visible. Left alignment is usually natural and readable, and right alignment can be achieved by counting spaces. Centering is harder: there is no half-space available for perfect visual balance.

text.zh: 原文将最棘手的情况指向两端对齐。若要让每一行同时触及左右边缘，词间空格往往不得不被拉大且分布不均。在等宽文本里，这种不规则会格外醒目，读者看到的可能不再是连贯的段落，而是一组被空隙打断的词。
text.en: The source identifies full justification as the most difficult case. To make every line reach both margins, spaces between words often need to grow and be distributed unevenly. In monospace text, that irregularity is particularly conspicuous: readers may see not a continuous paragraph, but words interrupted by gaps.

text.zh: 不用工具，而是重写句子
常规排版可以借助断词来缓解空格问题，但原文指出，在等宽环境中，连字符本身容易显得突兀，也会影响复制粘贴。因此，一份上世纪 90 年代末的《超级银河战士》指南采用了更严格的方法：调整措辞，让每行文字恰好达到目标长度，同时避免出现双空格。
text.en: Conventional typesetting can use hyphenation to relieve spacing problems, but the source argues that hyphens can look obtrusive in a monospace setting and can interfere with copying and pasting. A Super Metroid guide from the late 1990s instead took a stricter route: it adjusted wording so each line reached its target length while avoiding double spaces.

text.zh: 据原文介绍，这种做法延续了约 17,000 个词，右边界都以字母结束。作者在文末问答中称没有使用排版程序，而是在 ASCII 编辑器中仔细选择用词。这并不只是把空格当作技术问题，而是把句子的表达方式也纳入版面约束。
text.en: According to the source, this approach continued for roughly 17,000 words, with each right margin ending on a letter. In a closing FAQ, the guide's author said no typesetting program was used; the work was done in an ASCII editor through careful word choice. This treats not only spaces as a technical problem, but also sentence phrasing as subject to layout constraints.

text.zh: 文字质量与版面限制相互塑造
text.en: How Copy and Layout Shape Each Other

text.zh: 这件事的价值在于它展示了一种极端而具体的编辑劳动：形式要求反过来影响语言选择。这样的办法未必适合一般屏幕写作，也未必比现代排版系统更高效；但它说明，版面并非总是内容完成后才处理的外层包装。
text.en: Its value lies in showing an unusually exacting form of editorial labor: formal requirements feed back into language choices. The method may not suit ordinary screen writing, nor necessarily be more efficient than modern typesetting systems. But it demonstrates that layout is not always an outer layer applied only after content is finished.

text.zh: 原文也将这种经历与更日常的工作联系起来：在紧凑界面中，人们常为让按钮标签或提示文字适配固定宽度而反复改写。两者的规模不同，但共同点是明确的——当空间有限时，好的文案既要准确传意，也要在所处的容器中安放得当。
text.en: The source connects this experience to more familiar work: in dense interfaces, people often repeatedly revise a button label or tooltip so it fits a fixed width. The scale differs, but the shared lesson is clear: when space is limited, good copy must convey meaning accurately and sit well within its container.
